d:
Ameriki videsh mantri marko rubiyo chhah mahine ke bhitar dusri bar bharat daure par the. magar is bar vo dilli nahin gae. unke daure ki shuruaat munbaee se huee, jiske bad vo gujrat ke jamangar bhi gae. rubiyo ke is daure ko lekar kaphi charcha ho rahi hai.
Saval uth rahe hain ki rubiyo dilli jane ki bajay jamangar kyon pahunche? rilayans ki rifainri men unki maujudgi kya sirf ek karobari daura thi kya iske tar ameriki madhyavdhi chunavon se jure hain? ya iske pichhe bharat-amerika sanbandhon ki koee naee kahani chhipi hai?
